parts.title: PART 1: READING INPUT  The Heart: Pumping Life
content: Your heart is a muscle about the size of your fist.
It pumps blood every second of every day!
- Right side: Receives blood without oxygen → Sends to lungs
- Left side: Receives oxygen-rich blood → Pumps to whole body
- Arteries: Carry blood AWAY from heart (oxygen-rich)
- Veins: Carry blood BACK to heart (needs oxygen)
- Capillaries: Tiny vessels connecting arteries and veins
- Your heart beats about 100,000 times per day!
- Blood travels about 19,000 km through your body daily!
- If you laid out all your blood vessels, they would circle Earth twice!

listening_script.speed_note: Read aloud at a normal, clear pace (85 wpm). Pause 2–3 seconds between sentences. Read the full text twice before students answer questions.
listening_script.text:
Your heart is a muscle about the size of your fist.
It pumps blood every second of every day!
HOW THE HEART WORKS:
1. The heart has 4 CHAMBERS (rooms)
- 2 atria (top) - receive blood
- 2 ventricles (bottom) - pump blood out
2. THE BLOOD FLOW:
- Right side: Receives blood without oxygen → Sends to lungs
- Lungs: Blood gets oxygen
- Left side: Receives oxygen-rich blood → Pumps to whole body
3. BLOOD VESSELS:
- Arteries: Carry blood AWAY from heart (oxygen-rich)
- Veins: Carry blood BACK to heart (needs oxygen)
- Capillaries: Tiny vessels connecting arteries and veins
FUN FACTS:
- Your heart beats about 100,000 times per day!
- Blood travels about 19,000 km through your body daily!
- If you laid out all your blood vessels, they would circle Earth twice!
Science Vocabulary:
dictation: Your heart is a muscle about the size of your fist.
It pumps blood every second of every day!
